card.description: A towering basalt obelisk, 12 m tall and 200 tons, etched with luminous blue hieroglyphs that pulse in sync with a crystalline core at its apex. The core hums with unseen energy, projecting holographic glyphs onto the surrounding stone walls. It serves as a conduit between the ancient temple and a hidden machine, embodying the fusion of Ethiopian and Egyptian mysticism with incomprehensible technology.
visual_anatomy: **Body/Form:** Monolithic basalt shaft, 12 m tall, tapering to a pointed apex, weight ~200 tons, rough, weathered texture with subtle lichen growth.
**Face/Sensors:** Translucent crystal array embedded in the apex emits pulsing blue light; vibration sensors trace ambient vibrations and translate them into glyph illumination.
**Key Features:** Luminescent glyphs, crystalline core, vibration sensors, energy conduit, ancient metal fittings, subtle dust accumulation.
evolution: Phase 1 (Dormant): The obelisk stands silent, glyphs faint, core inert, ambient light barely illuminating the stone.
Phase 2 (Activated): Glyphs glow intensely, core hums, energy flows, holographic projections of hieroglyphs appear on surrounding walls.
